The minimum and recommended hardware requirements for running the virtual machine are as follow:

**Minimum requirements:**

Memory (RAM): 2 GB

Disk space: 3 GB

Processor: 1-core CPU

**Recommended requirements:**

Memory (RAM): 8 GB

Disk space: 10 GB

Processor: 2-core CPU
